name: Shaka Laka Boom Boom
description: Anything that is drawn using the magical pencil found by Sanju, a young boy, becomes a reality. Soon, Sanju finds himself battling many evil forces who wish to misuse the pencil.

videos.title: Sanju Gets a Magical Pencil
videos.overview: Changu and Mangu kill the thief while chasing him on the road. Ritu and Sanju mock Chandu’s father as Chandu’s mother is insulting his father. Sanju gets the magic pencil in the park while he goes to check the burglar.

videos.title: Punishment For Sanju
videos.overview: Sweety advises her boss to use the exchange offer to get the pencil. Chandu breaks Lalita Behan’s window and gives the bat in Sanju’s hand so as to lay blame on him for breaking the glass. Lalita Behan takes Sanju to her mother to complain about him.

videos.title: Sanju Gives Chocolates
videos.overview: Sanju uses the magical pencil to have chocolates. He gives chocolates to everybody in his class. Changu, Mangu and Sweety visit Sanju’s society in search of the magical pencil. Partho asks all his friends about the exchange offer for the old pencil.

videos.title: Sanju Ka Interview
videos.overview: Changu and Mangu take his boss to Sanju’s house as he faints while walking on the road. Sanju takes the doctor to his house. Tarsem Singh calls the news reporter and asks them to come for Sanju’s interview as he has saved a man’s life.

videos.title: Chandu is Punished
videos.overview: Chandu troubles his classmates with a fake lizard. The teacher punishes him for throwing a scorpion at her. Later, Chandu complains to the teacher about Sanju.

videos.title: Sanju’s Red Hot Offering!
videos.overview: Sanju exchanges his lunch box with his friend to teach Chandu a lesson. He mixes red pepper in his lunch box and offers it to Chandu. Meanwhile, Sweety takes her boss to meet Kaalicharan to find the magic pencil.

videos.title: Sanju’s New Car!
videos.overview: When Karuna tells Sanju that Chandu’s father has bought a new car, he draws a car on the paper with his magic pencil! Later, Tarshen takes Sanju and his friends on a long drive.

videos.title: Sanju Surprises His Friends
videos.overview: Raj does not allow Sanju and his friends to play, and tells them to sit in the room. Sanju tells his friends to leave the room one at a time and wait for him outside as he has a cool surprise for them.

videos.title: Sanju Challenges Neeraj
videos.overview: Neeraj beats Jaggu and takes his ice cream. Sanju draws a band-aid with his magic pencil for Jaggu. Later, Sanju challenges Neeraj to a tug-of-war, but there’s a catch!

videos.title: Sanju Goes Bowling
videos.overview: Neeraj assures his friends that they will beat Sanju’s team in bowling. Meanwhile, Sanju asks the instructor to teach them the rules of bowling. Sanju uses his magic pencil to get shoes and dress for his team,

videos.title: Will Sanju's Team Win?
videos.overview: The instructor praises Sanju and his team for learning the game so quickly. The parents come to encourage Sanju and his team. Later, Ritu encourages Sanju before the final throw.

videos.title: Sanju Gets a Puppy For Karuna
videos.overview: Karuna tells Sanju that she wants to keep a puppy as her pet. Sanju draws a puppy with his magic pencil, gives it to Karuna. He then lies to his friends that he got the puppy from one of his other friends.

videos.title: Sanju Hides The Puppy
videos.overview: Sanju and his friends hide the puppy from their parents. Later, the society members hold a meeting and everyone decides not to keep pets in the society.

videos.title: Sanju Plans to Meet Fruity
videos.overview: Sanju feels happy on reading Fruity’s mail. He is surprised that they have common interests and plan to meet each other.

videos.title: Sanju, Fruity Get Trapped
videos.overview: Sanju and Fruity get trapped in the basement water. However, Sanju helps her in retrieving her crystal ball with the help of his magic pencil. Maharaj is enlightened to know about the magic pencil. Later, Deepak reveals to Kanthila about Fruity.

videos.title: Fruity is Kidnapped
videos.overview: Partho asks Sanju to show Fruity’s pictures to his friends. Sanju's friends underestimate him and don’t believe him to have met Fruity. Kanthila kidnaps Fruity after tracing her address. Gulab Chacha tells Sanju about Fruity’s kidnapping.

videos.title: Will Sanju Find Fruity?
videos.overview: Gulab informs Sanju about Fruity’s abduction. While lookingfor Fruity, they find her watch. Sanju and his friends follow the kidnappers. Later, Sanju’s friends wish to give up the idea of searching for Fruity.

videos.title: Jaggu’s Birthday Party
videos.overview: While Karuna explains to her parents about event management, her mother suggests a business idea. Sanju promises Karuna in organising Jaggu’s birthday party. He gets a cook with the help of his magic pencil. Will things go smoothly?

videos.title: Sanju Gets Caught
videos.overview: Sanju gets a ladder with the help of his magic pencil and enters the kidnappers’ hideout. He gets caught by the kidnappers and is tied up beside Fruity. Later, he lures the guards with the magic pencil.

videos.title: Chandu Creates Chaos
videos.overview: Chandu stops the water supply in the building. The residents send the watchman to fetch a plumber. The plumbers open the valve to resume the supply. The residents of the building learn about a mentally challenged patient, who has fled from an asylum.

videos.title: Sanju has a New Plan
videos.overview: Two mentally retarded siblings enter the house to catch Sanju and his friends. Sanju comes up with an idea to teach the two a lesson, while the cops take Tiger and Sweety in their custody, assuming them to be the disabled patients.

videos.title: Will The Plan Succeed?
videos.overview: Sanju and his friends try to hide from the siblings, who are looking for them. Later, Sanju, with the help of his magic pencil, succeeds in trapping them and getting them arrested.

videos.title: Sanju Loses His Pencil
videos.overview: While Uma sends Sanju to a neighbour’s house, Karuna approaches her and takes the magic pencil away. When Sanju asks Chandu for his pencil, Chandu refuses and instead, gives it to a beggar. Tiger is looking for a beggar and he lands up with the one who has the magic pencil.

videos.title: Sanju Wants His Pencil Back
videos.overview: Sanju and his friends try to search for the magic pencil, while Tiger and his associates are also looking for it. Who will find the pencil first?

videos.title: Sanju Tests Sherdil's Bravery
videos.overview: Sherdil brags about his courage before the society members. To test his claim, Sanju draws a ghost with his magic pencil. How will Sherdil react?

videos.title: Sherdil Takes Tantric’s Help
videos.overview: Sharad tells the society members about the theft in his house. They request Sherdil to catch the thief, disguised as a ghost. Sherdil takes the help of a tantric to protect him from the ghost!

videos.title: Will Sanju Get His Pencil Back?
videos.overview: Chaurasia steals Sanju’s magic pencil. Tiger becomes irritated when his crystal ball does not change its colour. Chandu taunts Sanju when he learns about his habit of drinking milk. Sweety interrogates Chaurasia about the pencil.

videos.title: Changu and Mangu In Disguise
videos.overview: Sanju draws a few gifts for his friend, who is admitted to the hospital. Meanwhile, Changu and Mangu disguise themselves as ward boys and visit the hospital to steal the magic pencil.

videos.title: Can Sanju Bring Peace?
videos.overview: Chandu's mischief leads to a fight among the society members. Will Sanju and his friends bring the harmony back?

videos.title: Will Sanju Reunite The Families?
videos.overview: Sanju comes up with a plan to reunite the families. Will the kids be able to get their parents to reconcile?

videos.title: Sanju Scares Chandu
videos.overview: While Chandu spoils Sanju’s art, Sanju spills water on Chandu’s shirt. Sanju gets a frog to scare Chandu with the help of his magical pencil. On his way back home, Sanju finds an injured man and takes him to a hospital.

videos.title: Sanju Helps Karuna
videos.overview: Sanju’s father tells him about his mother’s kitty party. Sanju plans to bring a smile on Karuna’s face and with the help of his magical pencil, gets chocolates for her. Later, the teacher spares Karuna with a warning when she fails to complete her homework.

videos.title: Who is The New Neighbour?
videos.overview: Sanju crashes into the new members of the society. When he learns that the couple has lost their key, he gets them one through his magical drawing. The lady argues with the society members. Chaurasia requests Karuna to deliver milk to the new tenants.

videos.title: Bhalla Warns The Neighbours
videos.overview: Bhalla complains to the building members about their children. Mrs. Bhalla locks the terrace to stop the kids from going there. While Sharad threatens Bhalla to get the key, Sanju decides to teach him a lesson.

videos.title: Sanju Scares Bhalla
videos.overview: Bhalla humiliates Dinu Kaka in front of the building members. Sanju leaves a dog at Bhalla’s house and scares him and Mrs Bhalla. Later, Sanju and his friends further frighten Bhalla and make him believe that there is a ghost in his flat.

videos.title: Sanju Loses The Pencil
videos.overview: Kalicharan makes magical water that shows the location of the magic pencil. Chandu locks Ritu in the school’s toilet to ensure that she will not be able to complain against him. Later, Sanju is worried as he is not able to find his pencil.

videos.title: Sanju Finds Ritu
videos.overview: Sanju goes to get his pencil back from school after he realises he has forgotten it there. Tiger also reaches there along with others to get the pencil. Later, Sanju finds Ritu in the school and brings her home.

videos.title: Sanju Prepares For The Drama
videos.overview: The teacher announces a drama competition in the school. Sanju and his friends choose Alladin's story for the drama and start the preparations. Meanwhile, Kalicharan throws a fireball to find the pencil.

videos.title: Kalicharan Makes a New Plan
videos.overview: Kalicharan comes up with another plan to get the magic pencil after Sanju foils his previous plan. Sanju keeps the pencil inside a red box and rehearses for his play. Will Kalicharan succeed this time?

videos.title: Sanju's Play In Trouble!
videos.overview: Sanju comes to Karuna's rescue when she is upset as her costume is not ready. Tito’s mother confronts Tito when she learns that he has failed in his science exam. How will Sanju manage this situation now?

videos.title: Arun Steals Sanju's Pencil
videos.overview: Sanju creates a genie with his pencil and rescues Jasmine when Tiger and Kalicharan create a scene onstage. Sanju's play wins the first prize. Later, Arun steals Sanju's pencil and challenges him for a competition.

videos.title: Sanju's Exam Prep Disturbed
videos.overview: Sanju, Karuna and Jaggu study together for their exams. Chandu removes the fuse of the society so that no one is able to study. Will Sanju's magic pencil help him this time too?

videos.title: Sanju Finds The Culprit
videos.overview: Chandu steals the questionnaire from Sanju's room. Later, Sanju feels that the question paper has been leaked. Will he find the culprit?

videos.title: Sanju's Gift For Karuna!
videos.overview: Sanju and his friends participate in a fancy dress competition with their guardians. He presents a pretty dress to Karuna to wear at the competition. Later, Tiger and his associates also reach the program venue.

videos.title: Fancy Dress Competition
videos.overview: Everyone decides to leave the fancy dress competition as they get drenched. Tiger, disguised as Santa Claus, takes the bag in which Sanju has hidden the pencil. Sanju sees the bag with Tiger. Will he get it back?

videos.title: Raj and Sanju do The Chores
videos.overview: Raj and Sanju accept a challenge by Uma to complete the household chores without any difficulty. Will they realise how difficult the job is?

videos.title: Chandu Arranges Surprise Party
videos.overview: Karuna and her mother warn Deepu to be careful while investing money. Meanwhile, Chandu secretly plans a surprise birthday party for his mother and takes Sanju's magical pencil while searching for the party items.

videos.title: Planning a Heist!
videos.overview: Tito misplaces the pencil when Chandu holds him by his shirt. Meanwhile, Tiger gets the idea of robbing a bank which has weak security, unaware that Deepu too, has hatched a similar plan.

videos.title: The Bank Heist
videos.overview: Tiger and his associates plan to rob a bank. Karuna's father also plans to rob the same bank. All of them arrive at the same time to carry out the heist!

videos.title: Chandu, The Hero!
videos.overview: Sudha is worried that Chandu is trapped inside the bank. But he succeeds in escaping from the robbers. Meanwhile, Kalicharan tells Crystal that Tiger is very close to the magic pencil.

videos.title: Sanju is a Good Samaritan
videos.overview: Sanju and his friends decide to arrange money to treat Ratna's heart ailment. They decide to organise a star night with celebrities to arrange for the money. Will Sanju's plan work?

videos.title: Who is The Kidnapper?
videos.overview: While the audience get angry on seeing the celebrities' duplicates, Partho's father tells them the truth. Later, the parents get worried reading the news about the kidnapper.

videos.title: Sanju Suspects a Stranger
videos.overview: Sanju and Ritu spot a suspicious man in their society. A new member, Hasmukh comes to the society and befriends Sanju. Is Hasmukh what he looks like?

videos.title: Sanju Learns About The Kidnapper
videos.overview: Sanju keeps an eye on Atma, who watches over the kids. Later, Jaggu, Atma and Hasmukh go missing. Meanwhile, Changu and Mangu try to find out about the kidnapper from the police. Later, everyone is in for a rude shock!

videos.title: Jaggu is Saved
videos.overview: Hasmukh demands a ransom from Sharad to release Jaggu. Sharad takes help from the police. Sanju finds clues that help Sharad and Atma save Jaggu.

videos.title: Kalicharan Performs a Yagna
videos.overview: Atma sees Sanju drawing with his magic pencil. Sanju finds something strange in Atma's room. Meanwhile, Kalicharan performs a yagna in order to get the magic pencil.

videos.title: Is Sanju In Danger?
videos.overview: Although initially, she stops Sanju and his friends to light the crackers, Lalita later gives them permission. Meanwhile, Kalicharan sends Bramha Rakshas to kidnap Sanju!

videos.title: Atma to Save Sanju
videos.overview: Sanju tricks Bramha Rakshas and sends him away. At Sanju's insistence, Atma tells him that he has come from future to protect him. Later, Atma tries to mislead Kalicharan about the magic pencil.

videos.title: Atma Returns to His Age
videos.overview: Atma and Sanju succeed to destroy Bramha Rakshas. Before returning to his age, Atma warns Sanju to be aware of the evil powers and gifts him a watch. Later, Kalicharan determines to reach out to the magic pencil.

videos.title: Jhumroo, Sanju's New Friend
videos.overview: Out of imagination, Sanju sketches a person, who will act as a saviour to everyone. Later, he is surprised to see the person in real and names him Jhumroo. Meanwhile, Kalicharan gets to know about the death of Bramha Rakshas.

videos.title: Jhumroo Goes Missing
videos.overview: Sanju leaves after asking Jhumroo to hide if anyone entered the room. Kalicharan asks Tiger to give him money to locate the magic pencil. Later, Jhumroo goes missing!

videos.title: Sanju Decides to Find Jhumroo
videos.overview: Changu and Mangu kidnap Jhumroo and inform Tiger about it. Meanwhile, Sanju is worried about Jhumroo’s absence. Will Sanju find him?

videos.title: Sanju's Parents Doubts Him
videos.overview: Sanju realises that his parents are experiencing strange things in the house because of Jhumroo. He clears Jhumroo's confusion, who is scared on seeing himself in the mirror. Will Sanju's parents learn about Jhumroo?

videos.title: Jhumroo Goes Out Alone!
videos.overview: Jhumroo goes out in search of Sanju, as he has left the magic pencil at home. After returning from school, Sanju feels relieved to see the pencil. Meanwhile, Kalicharan strives to find a way to reach out to it.

videos.title: Who will Teach Music to Sanju?
videos.overview: Uma suspects Sanju's strange behaviour. The music teacher calls Sanju and his friends for rehearsals. Later, Dhiraj informs them that the music teacher will not be able to teach them.

videos.title: Conspiracy Against Sanju
videos.overview: Determined to win the singing competition, Sanju and his friends practice hard. On the day of the competition, the music teacher convinces Sanju to drink a syrup, which might damage his voice.

videos.title: Sanju's Team Wins The Competition
videos.overview: As Sanju's voice gets choked, he seeks Jhumroo's help to perform at the singing competition. Later, Sanju and his friends are happy to win the competition.

videos.title: Tito is Confused
videos.overview: Sanju's friends thank Jhumroo for winning the competition and plan to celebrate their victory. Meanwhile, Tito is confused, on seeing Jhumroo's activities.

videos.title: Jhumroo Falls Sick
videos.overview: Kalicharan is happy with Jumbo for kidnapping Pandit Sargam Singh and Dhiraj, believing them to be the owners of the magic pencil. Later, Jhumroo eats all the food made by Sanju's pencil!

videos.title: Sanju Drops The Pencil
videos.overview: With the help of his magic pencil, Sanju satiates his hunger. He tells Jhumroo to stay hidden. Later, the pencil accidentally falls into Dipu's bag.

videos.title: Sanju's Search For The Pencil
videos.overview: Karuna's father gives the address of the person, who has the magic pencil, to Sanju. Meanwhile, Sweety and Mangu are also on the trail of the magic pencil. Who will get the pencil first?

videos.title: Will Sanju Find The Magic Pencil?
videos.overview: Some goons beat up Sharma and his worker as Sanju and Jhumroo reach his office in search of the magic pencil. Will they find it?

videos.title: Sanjana Blackmails Sanju
videos.overview: Sanju tells Sanjana to not tell his parents about Jhumroo. Meanwhile, Kalicharan is upset because his evil power cannot harm Jhumroo. Later, Sanjana blackmails Sanju.

videos.title: Sanju Saves Sanjana
videos.overview: Sanju plays a prank by drawing different things with the pencil and saves Sanjana from Mangu and Sweety. Sanjana suspects Sanju's weird behaviour. Later, Kalicharan gets the power to melt iron.

videos.title: Karan's Gift For Sanju
videos.overview: The parents complain to each other about their children at a kitty party in the neighbourhood. They stop their children from playing. Meanwhile, Karan leaves a gift for Sanju in his house.

videos.title: Sanju Rescues Jhumroo
videos.overview: Sanju saves Jhumroo by fighting Kalicharan with the help of a mirror. Mangu tells Sweety about Crystal's attack on him. Jhumroo is scared to steal the pencils, but Sanju wants to destroy them.

videos.title: Sanju and His Friends Reconcile
videos.overview: Sweety and Mangu find another set of pencils, but discover that those are fakes too. They go to Kalicharan, who tries to get Crystal back. Meanwhile, Sanju's friends visit him and return their pencils in exchange for his friendship.

videos.title: Kalicharan Catches Jhumroo
videos.overview: Mangu leads Kalicharan to the magic pencil. Later, Kalicharan tries to catch Jhumroo, but he escapes. Meanwhile, Chandu and Partho get into an argument in the school.

videos.title: Sanju's Masterplan
videos.overview: The feud between Chandu and Partho escalates, involving their mothers. Unable to go out with their friends, Sanju comes up with a plan to solve the problem.

videos.title: Sanju has a Problem
videos.overview: Sanju's mother tells him that his cousin, Sumit, is coming to stay with them. But Sanju is in a dilemma regarding Jhumroo. What will he do?

videos.title: Jhumroo Stays With Chandu
videos.overview: Sanju's friends decide to let Jhumroo stay with them until Sumit leaves. Chandu tries to get used to Jhumroo's routine, while Sanju tolerates Sumit.

videos.title: Jhumroo is Not Welcome
videos.overview: Jhumroo is disturbed by Chandu's snoring. Meanwhile, annoyed with Jhumroo's behaviour, Sanju's friends try to get rid of him.

videos.title: Thivim's Sweet Poison
videos.overview: After Sanju's friends reject him, Jhumroo decides to live in the garage. Meanwhile, Thivim disguises himself and retrieves Sweety's hair for the poison!

videos.title: Karuna Meets Jhumroo
videos.overview: Sanju's friends realise their mistakes and want to make amends with Jhumroo. Later, Karuna goes to have snow cones at Thivim's stall!

videos.title: Kalicharan Detains Karuna!
videos.overview: Thivim takes Karuna to Kalicharan's hideout to perform the sacrifice. Jhumroo follows her and tries to rescue her. Meanwhile, Sanju and Sanjana are worried about Jhumroo and Karuna. Will Jhumroo be able to rescue Karuna?

videos.title: Will Sanju Find Jhumroo?
videos.overview: Sanju gets a clue from the camera he has placed and talks to Jhumroo through telepathy. Meanwhile, Kalicharan is about to kill Jhumroo. Will Sanju get to Jhumroo in time?

videos.title: Karuna Suspects Sanju
videos.overview: Tiger's goons check on Kalicharan and rescue Thivim from the hideout. Meanwhile, Karuna is suspicious of Sanju's secret. Will she find out about Sanju's magic pencil?

videos.title: Sanju to Help Karuna
videos.overview: Jhumroo distracts Karuna when Sanju writes on the book with the magical pencil. Jhumroo tells Sanju about the problems in Karuna's house. How will Sanju help Karuna?

videos.title: Karuna Scolds Sanju
videos.overview: Karuna realises the financial crisis her parents are facing and shouts at Sanju for lying about the gift. Later, Sumit arrives at Karuna's house and taunts her about the party.

videos.title: Sanju Challenges Rocky
videos.overview: Sanju’s friends are worried when he challenges Rocky for a fight. Later, Sanju starts exercising to get fit and win the challenge.

videos.title: Sumit Wins The Fight!
videos.overview: Sumit comes to rescue Sanju. He beats Rocky and takes a promise from him that he will never underestimate his juniors. Meanwhile, Rocky vows to take revenge on Sanju and his friends.

videos.title: Sanju Accepts Rocky's Challenge
videos.overview: Tiger and his crew go in search of Kalicharan to the tree where he resides. Meanwhile, Sanju accepts Rocky's challenge to a boxing fight after four days.

videos.title: Will Sanju Fight Rocky?
videos.overview: Rocky locks Sanju inside a room and takes away his pencil. Karuna helps Sanju to get out of the room. Later, Sanju takes his pencil from Rocky’s friends by tricking them. Meanwhile, Raj tells Uma to ask Sanju to stop fighting with Rocky.

videos.title: Sanju Prepares For The Fight
videos.overview: Karuna ask Chandu to help Sanju while Jhumroo encourages Sanju to fight with Rocky. Tiger asks Tivim to get him the magic pencil. Later, Chandu anonymously calls Rocky and provides him with updates about Sanju.

videos.title: Chandu Misleads Sanju
videos.overview: Chandu tells Rocky about Sanju’s weakness. Sanju makes Chandu drink the tampered milk. Later, Chandu calls Sanju as an anonymous caller and updates him with a different match location.

videos.title: Sanju Wins The Match!
videos.overview: Rocky asks Sanju to lose the match to save Raj’s job. Raj encourages Sanju and asks him to not worry about him. Later, Sanju wins the boxing match and Rocky is rusticated from the school.

videos.title: Tivim Kidnaps Jhumroo
videos.overview: All the kids are excited to go for a picnic while Tivim is anxious to take revenge of Kalicharan’s death. Sanju does not allow Jhumroo to go for the picnic. Later, Tivim abducts Jhumroo. Will Sanju learn about the kidnapping?

videos.title: Tivim and Sanju In Same Bus!
videos.overview: Tivim makes Jhumroo unconscious. Sanju and his friends enjoy on their way to the picnic till the bus halts as it is out of gas. Sanju creates a can filled with petrol with his magic pencil. Later, Tivim gets a lift from the same bus.

videos.title: Tivim Poisons The Food
videos.overview: Tivim poisons the water and food with his magic to kill Sanju. Meanwhile, Sanju gets suspicious as Chandu falls asleep. Will Sanju fall into Tivim's trap?

videos.title: Gangsters Hijack The Bus!
videos.overview: Sanju creates a tool box with his magic pencil. Meanwhile, the gangsters hijack the bus and demand the release of their team members and a hefty amount of Rs 50 crores. How will Sanju use his pencil to save everyone?

videos.title: Sanju Nabs The Terrorists
videos.overview: Sanju uses his pencil to distract the terrorists, while the other kids grab the opportunity to capture them. Meanwhile, the driver realises that the brakes of the bus are not working. What will Sanju do now?

videos.title: Sanju's On a Dharna!
videos.overview: Lalita tells the society members about selling the building. Sanju's plan for a hunger strike fails when the builder bribes the adults with money. How will the kids convince their parents and Lalita?

videos.title: An Inauspicious Deal?
videos.overview: Sanju and the gang protest by going on a hunger strike to stop the sale of the society. Soon, they stop Lalita from signing the deeds by making her believe that it is inauspicious.

videos.title: Sanju's Trick to Convince Lalita
videos.overview: Sanju tells his father that the builder has lied to them. Later, some goons arrive and demand that they leave their houses. So, Sanju makes a plan to convince Lalita not to sell the society.

videos.title: Sanju Bana Sadhu!
videos.overview: Sanju and Tito dress like saints and visit Lalita. They show the recorded video to Lalita. Lalita is shocked and refuses to sign the agreement papers. The builder blackmails Lalita into signing the papers but Jhumroo handles the situation.

videos.title: Sanju Saves Lalita
videos.overview: Lalita is happy as Sanju and his friends save her from the fraud builder. Raj is proud of Sanju and gives him a gift. Ritu praises Sanju in front of her friends. Later, Ritu and Tito have a tiff over the election.

videos.title: Sanju and Partho's Campaign
videos.overview: Ritu asks all the students to vote for Sanju whereas Tito wants the votes to go to Partho. Meanwhile, Sanju and Partho bribe the students for gaining votes.

videos.title: Who will Win The Elections?
videos.overview: Sanjana tells Jhumroo that Sanju and Partho are no more friends. Sanju recalls the time spent with his friends. Both Sanju and Partho realise their mistake. Ritu and Tito also feel guilty for their actions.

videos.title: Jhumroo's Good Turn
videos.overview: Tivim attains power to make a person stand in any position. Meanwhile, Jhumroo is touched on hearing a conversation of some poor kids. He dresses as a hawker and helps them.

videos.title: Jhumroo Searches For The Pencil
videos.overview: A worried Jhumroo searches for the pencil, but recalls that the pencil is with the truck driver. Meanwhile, Tivim can smell Jhumroo and starts searching for him!

videos.title: Jhumroo Finds The Pencil!
videos.overview: Jhumroo finds out that one of the kids is having the pencil and follows them. He manages to get the pencil but gets chased by Tivim and Changu. How will he escape Tivim's powers?

videos.title: Tiger Becomes a Minister!
videos.overview: Changu learns that the pencil is hidden inside the flag used for the school flag hoisting. Meanwhile, Tiger disguises himself as a minister for the flag hoisting. Will Sanju and Jhumroo be able to stop them from getting the pencil?

videos.title: Sanju On a Cleaning Spree
videos.overview: Tiger flees from the scene after Sanju exposes him. Later, Karuna takes Sanju's help to clean the house as her uncle plans to visit her. Will Sanju use his magic pencil to clean the house?

videos.title: Sanju's Plan For The Uncle
videos.overview: Vishambar plans to stay with Karuna for six months. After enduring a day of cruelty, Karuna seeks help from Sanju to get rid of her uncle and aunt. What will Sanju do?

videos.title: Sanju In The Haunted House!
videos.overview: Sanju draws Chachaji's picture and sends him to Karuna's house to teach a lesson to her guests. Meanwhile, Sanju takes up the challenge to spend a night at the haunted house!

videos.title: Sanju and The Ghost
videos.overview: The children enjoy Ritu's birthday party at the haunted house. Parthav feels the presence of a ghost. Meanwhile, Ritu disappears! Can the magic pencil help Sanju find her?

videos.title: Sanju Searches For Ritu
videos.overview: Sanju vows to find Ritu and Partho before leaving the mansion. He refuses to believe that the mansion is haunted and tells his friends that someone is trying to scare them.

videos.title: Sanju's Shocking Discovery!
videos.overview: Sanju finds out that someone is scaring them with ghost costumes and masks and turns off the music. Later, while searching for Sanjana and Tito, he makes a shocking discovery!

videos.title: Sanju Solves The Mystery
videos.overview: Sanju brings the electricity back with the help of his magic pencil. He finds the secret door and gets his friends back. The children come to know the truth about the ghost. How will Sanju and his group escape from the place?

videos.title: Sanju Becomes Invisible!
videos.overview: Tivim gets the magic pencil. Sanju wakes up and realises that he has become invisible and also finds his pencil missing. Meanwhile, Sweety is happy to have the magic pencil.

videos.title: Where is Sanju's Magic Pencil?
videos.overview: Sanju prevents the other kids from giving their name for the competition. Meanwhile, Tivim makes the magic pencil disappear and sends Mangu to bring Sanju to find the pencil.

videos.title: Sanju Sees Red!
videos.overview: Sanju realises that he is visible only in the red light. Meanwhile, his classmates are worried about his absence as the debate competition approaches. How will Sanju participate in the debate?

videos.title: Jhumroo, Sanju Help Aditi
videos.overview: Sanju learns about Aditi's financial problem. He and Jhumroo set out to help her. Will the magic pencil settle all her problems?

videos.title: Jhumroo Makes The Show a Success
videos.overview: Jhumroo leads his team for the play. Meanwhile, the boss learns about Jhumroo's magical pencil. Later, the minister makes an important decision about Aditi's education.

videos.title: Sanju Helps Sundar
videos.overview: Sanju and Jhumroo help Sundar in gifting a candle to his girlfriend Kanika. Meanwhile, Sundar's mother has already selected a bride for him. What will Sundar do?

videos.title: Sundar Vows to Marry Kanika!
videos.overview: Sanju and Jhumroo are concerned about Sundar. Sundar vows to marry Kanika. She tries to convince his mother. Will she accept her?

videos.title: Sanju Learns a Shocking Truth
videos.overview: Sanju is surprised after receiving letters with ancient stamps. He comes to know that he was adopted by his parents after reading the letter. He gets depressed and his friends learn about it.

videos.title: Is Sanju Adopted?
videos.overview: Sanju's friends get convinced that even they are adopted and decide to accompany Sanju. Later, they tell their parents about Sanju's adoption. Will Sanju's mother learn the truth before it's too late?

videos.title: Ritu Battles With Tito
videos.overview: Ritu gives her name for strength building while Jaggu signs up for the cooking classes in the school's extra curricular activities. Everyone makes fun of Ritu and Jaggu for their choices.

videos.title: Sanju Helps Ritu Train
videos.overview: Sanju uses his magic pencil to obtain weights for Ritu to exercise. Jhumru helps Jaggu with his cooking. Meanwhile, Ritu's parents refuse to give permission to her and Jaggu to go for the competition. Can Sanju help them convince their parents?

videos.title: It's Ritu Versus Tito!
videos.overview: Jagoo manages to impress the judges by his cooking, while Ritu faces Tito in the arm wrestling competition. Will she be able to defeat him?

videos.title: Sanju Saves a Life
videos.overview: Sanju draws an ambulance to pick up a man thrown out of a moving car. The man murmurs something to Sanju before being taken inside the hospital. What did he say?

videos.title: Jhumroo and Sanju Rescue Dr Nair
videos.overview: Jhumroo and Sanju succeed in rescuing Dr Nair when Boss’s associates try to attack him. Sanju informs the police about the incident, while Jhumroo visits a research institute to gather information about Dr Nair.

videos.title: Jhumroo Learns Everything
videos.overview: Sanju’s teacher wants him to participate in the science exhibition. Meanwhile, Jhumroo on his mission to find out the secret of the time machine discovers that Dr Uljhan is planning to kill Dr Nair. What will he do now?

videos.title: Tiger Gets The Time Machine
videos.overview: The Chinese brothers find the time machine and transport it to Tiger's hideout. Jhumroo follows them and makes his way inside Tiger's mansion. But, how will he take back the time machine?

videos.title: Jhumroo Hides Inside The Machine
videos.overview: Jhumroo escapes with the time machine, but one of the goons tracks him down. The rest of the gang arrives and surrounds Sanju and Jhumroo. Later, Jhumroo hides inside the time machine.

videos.title: Jhumroo Goes Missing!
videos.overview: Sanju searches for Jhumroo, while he is stuck in the machine. Sanju visits Dr. Nayak to ask about Jhumroo's whereabouts. Will they find him?

videos.title: Sanju Meets Jhumroo
videos.overview: Sanju meets Jhumroo in the jungle but fails to recognise him. He thinks that Jumroo is trying to harm him, while Jumroo tells Sanju that his face has changed. Will Sanju believe him?

videos.title: Sanju Versus Teacher
videos.overview: Jhumroo saves Sanju from the punishment given by the sports teacher. This infuriates the teacher even more and he takes revenge on Sanju in the class. Will Jhumroo be able to help Sanju again?

videos.title: Jhumroo is Now Karan
videos.overview: Sanju introduces Jhumroo to his friends and parents as Karan. Karan starts staying in Sanju's society and applies for a hockey teacher's post in Sanju's school.

videos.title: Karan vs Piya
videos.overview: The principal decides to put both Karan and Piya as hobby teachers for a period of one week before the selection. Meanwhile, Sanju is bent on getting Karan as the hobby teacher, while Dushyant decides to help Piya.

videos.title: Karan Bakes a Cake
videos.overview: The principal announces that Karan and Piya have to make a cake for the competition. Piya doesn't know to make a cake and Sanju tries to make sure that she loses the round.

videos.title: It's Karan vs Piya
videos.overview: There is a competition between Karan and Piya and the winner will be the hockey teacher. All the girls support Piya, while all the boys support Karan. Can Karan win the competition?

videos.title: Karan Loses His Voice
videos.overview: Karan is unable to speak or sing. Later, in the crafts round, Sanju helps Karan to make Piya lose. Will Piya keep quiet after losing the round?

videos.title: Karan In Trouble Again!
videos.overview: Piya and the girls want to teach Karan and the boys a lesson. There is a flower arrangement competition. Piya changes Karan's bouquet and writes a note. How will Karan prove himself innocent?

videos.title: Equal Votes For Karan, Piya
videos.overview: Piya saves the boys from the principal. The principal asks the students to vote for Piya and Karan. Piya and Karan get equal votes. Who will be the final choice?finally selected as the hockey teacher?

videos.title: Karan is In Love!
videos.overview: Sanju and his friends come to a conclusion that Karan is in love. Meanwhile, the sports teacher finds out that Karan likes Piya and tries to stop him. What will Karan do now?

videos.title: Dushyant's Heroic Plan
videos.overview: Dushyant impresses Piya by bringing stuff she likes and invites her to a Holi party. He hires some goons to tease her and plans to protect her like a hero. How will Karan stop this and impress Piya at the party?

videos.title: Karan, Piya Getting Closer?
videos.overview: Karan gets injured in front of Piya in order to gain her sympathy. Later, he tries to help Piya in preparing for a play. Will Piya and Karan come closer?

videos.title: Sanju Keeps Dushyant Away
videos.overview: Karan pretends to have recovered to help Piya with the play. Meanwhile, Sanju sends Titu as the healer to keep Dushyant away. Later, the principal brings on board a popular and recognised director for the play.

videos.title: Karan Tries Acting
videos.overview: The drama teacher selects Piya to play the female lead in his play. Meanwhile, Karan and Dushyant audition for Zorro's role, but fail.

videos.title: Tito Motivates Karan
videos.overview: Karan fails to deliver his dialogues and stares dumbstruck at Piya. Tito motivates Karan to rehearse his lines. Later, Dushyant, too tries hard to get the role.

videos.title: Dushyant to Play Monasterio
videos.overview: Kalidas begins the casting process for his play. Later, the principal announces that the play will determine if the school will get a grant or not. Meanwhile, Dushyant beats Karan with his sword fighting skills.

videos.title: Karan Bares His Heart
videos.overview: The principal reminds everyone that the grant rests on the play's success. The kids support Karan when he picks up a fight with Dushyant and his men. Later, Karan reveals his feelings to Piya.

videos.title: Dushyant Challenges Karan
videos.overview: Karan takes Piya out on a date but Dushyant follows them. Dushyant challenges Karan for a sports event. Later, Chandu and his friends train Karan and prepare him for the events.

videos.title: Karan vs. Dushyant
videos.overview: Dushyant and Karan have a weight lifting competition. Karan cheats and wins the first round. The next day, Karan faces Dushyant in an arm wrestling competition. Will he defeat Dushyant?

videos.title: Tiger Holds The Students Hostage
videos.overview: Karan arrives in time for the boxing match against Dushyant. Later, Tiger and his goons hold the student hostage. How will Karan save them?

videos.title: Will Karan Rescue The Students?
videos.overview: Karan tries to rescue the students, while Tiger and his men hold them hostage. Later, a scientist finds the magic pencil in the classroom and insists that Karan give it to Tiger.
